Aisha (Docs): Heads-up — I'm opening a tiny umbrella PR to migrate the console examples from the old `trace_ctx` helper to the new `trace_context` shape. Need a quick sanity check before I push.
Ben (Eng): Thanks — can you list the places? I can run a grep across the repo.
Aisha (Docs): Sure, rough list: docs/dashboard/*, docs/tracing/hooks.md, console/snippets/kv-cache.md and the SDK snippets folder. Found 8 direct occurrences.
Caroline (DevEx): Also check the quickstart embed samples — a bunch of our SDK examples pull that helper.
Aisha (Docs): Good call. There's also a cost/latency breakdown snippet in observability/latency-cost.md that references the old param names.
Ben (Eng): If it's just a rename we can do a sed script. I'll attach in a sec.
Marco (SRE): Keep an eye on the tracing hook example that sets `span.sample_rate` — we changed the key to `span.sampling.probability` last quarter. That one needs manual check.
Aisha (Docs): Ugh, yep. That one should stay manual.
Olga (QA): I can run a smoke on the rendered snippets after the change — make sure codeblocks still format and links don't 404.
Aisha (Docs): Here's the sed I'll use (preview):
```bash
# replace trace_ctx -> trace_context safely
git grep -l "trace_ctx" | xargs -n1 sed -i.bak 's/trace_ctx/trace_context/g'
# then check the altered files
git status --porcelain
```
Caroline (DevEx): Nice. Add a commit message like: "docs(snippets): rename trace_ctx -> trace_context and fix tracing/latency examples"
Ben (Eng): Also include a short changelog note in the migration guide (docs/migration/observability.md) so customers know the param rename.
Aisha (Docs): Will do. What about links — I found two internal links in dashboard samples that point to legacy dashboard IDs.
Marco (SRE): Use the dashboard alias redirect we added last month: /dashboards/v2/aliases/<old-id> — that way we don't break customers.
Aisha (Docs): Good idea, I'll rewrite to that pattern instead of hardcoding v1 paths.
DocBot: Reminder: docs CI will run prettier + linkcheck on PR open.
Olga (QA): After CI passes I'll run the snippet render test and post screenshots here.
Ben (Eng): Quick FYI: our SDK snippet generator had a bug that duplicated args in Python examples — opened #5021 to fix it. If that lands before this PR we should re-run snippet generation.
Aisha (Docs): Marking this as draft for now. My checklist: 1) run sed, 2) manually fix sampling key, 3) update migration guide, 4) validate links, 5) regenerate SDK snippets if #5021 lands, 6) QA screenshots, 7) merge.
Caroline (DevEx): I'll review once it's ready. Try to keep each commit focused (rename-only vs manual fixes) so the CI diffs are small.
Aisha (Docs): Cool — targeting to have a PR up within the hour. Ping me if you see anything weird in the sed output. :thumbsup: 
Ben (Eng): Will do.
Olga (QA): I'll standby for the PR link and run smoke after CI.
Aisha (Docs): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/?? (will update once created)
Caroline (DevEx): thanks — appreciate the heads up.
Aisha (Docs): closing thread here after PR lands, will post final QA images.
